as_told.title: UFO link to the JFK assassination

plain: The claim is that UFOs and the 1963 killing of President John F. Kennedy are connected, and that the link can be shown on paper. The author Peter Levenda says he has done just that: "I've shown through documentation the connection with the UFO phenomenon and the Kennedy assassination." He points to his book Sinister Forces. The people he names include J. Edgar Hoover, the head of the FBI, the former CIA officer E. Howard Hunt, and the men Guy Banister, Jack Martin and Fred Crisman. The UFO historian Richard Dolan reaches a similar view by a different path. He says "the UFO subject" must be "brought into" the Kennedy story, and he credits sources he names as Philip Lavell and Dan Sheehan rather than Levenda's work. Both raise it because, if true, it would tie the UFO secret to one of the darkest events in American history.
